column1: # Wiki page mappings: repository file, tab, wiki page name.
# Chinese pages keep their existing names; English pages use the same names with an `-EN` suffix.
# List both languages here and in wiki-sidebar.md, with Chinese first. Use hyphens instead of spaces
# in page names. The publishing script checks that the sidebar and mappings cover the same pages.
# Language switches link to the translated wiki page when both source files are listed here.
# A translation missing from this mapping will link to the source repository instead.
# English: the same pages, in the same order.
